bijective-mersenne-pairing.last_note: 2:1 length-ratio pairing mechanism refuted on the outline's own required generic test case (verified exact-fraction computation, composition (2,0,0) with p1->{3,7/10,3/10}): no length-ratio pairing exists between even/odd regions. Correctly abandoned per outline's stop condition. RETHINK.
bijective-mersenne-pairing.summary: Direct piece-to-piece pairing on the final cut multiset as a whole (no top/tail generation split at all), pairing each odd-rank fragment with a same-generation-agnostic "shadow" fragment at a fixed 2:1 ratio matching the ladder's own doubling, reusing aimo-0915/aimo-0596 pairing templates. Deliberately cheap: gated on a go/no-go test against the fully-known n=2 case (10 compositions) before further investment -- the riskiest and least-targeted of this round's three new approaches.

claiming-order-invariant.last_note: RETHINK. Rigorous structural argument that aimo-0117's "defer commitment" invariant mechanism cannot transplant: the marking stage is a one-shot Stackelberg game (no multi-round loop for an invariant to inductively maintain), and the claiming stage is already a fully-determined mechanical sort (claiming-subgame-reduction), leaving no strategic freedom for an order-invariant to exploit. Confirmed by numeric check: outline's candidate invariant fails at the very first step against the on-file n=3 example. No repair proposed, correctly -- diagnosis rules out any invariant of this shape. Valuable, well-reasoned dead end; do not re-attempt this framing.
claiming-order-invariant.summary: Branch of self-similar-potential-certificate retargeting the "certificate" philosophy at claiming ORDER instead of final-multiset structure (aimo-0117-style per-move invariant: "largest unclaimed piece is dominated by running-total gap"), adapted from a genuinely sequential game to this problem's fixed-marks claiming subgame. Speculative -- translation not immediate, explorer's own #2 (lower-confidence) pick. Candidate invariant not yet even numerically checked against the n=3 example.

dyadic-band-occupancy.last_note: New slug, first build. Proved 2 fully general reusable propositions (band-decomposition identity; cardinality-relaxed minimum is exactly 0, proving the finite cut budget is load-bearing) plus a rigorous counterexample refuting its own assigned coarse band-invariance conjecture -- correctly diagnosed that its coarse technique cannot close claim (A) without at least rank-pigeonhole-budget's finer per-band shape information. Real general lemmas produced but the assigned target (claim A) itself not advanced.
dyadic-band-occupancy.summary: Claim-(A) fixed-tail optimization via generating-function/step-function band-occupancy counting (coarser than rank-pigeonhole-budget's per-band decomposition, tracks only mass+count per dyadic band, not exact shape) — a genuinely new, non-LP technique for the same lower-bound gap.

exchange-argument-extremal-response.last_note: Independently proved the same vertex-reduction theorem (Lemma E1/E2, Theorem E3) via LP-vertex geometry, cross-checked against rank-tie-vertex-reduction's n=3 example, exact match. Corollary E4's multi-way-tie gap is already closed by the sibling's Odd-Run Reduction Lemma -- flag for next round. General enumeration still open.
exchange-argument-extremal-response.summary: Fixes a hypothetical Xiang-Yu response minimizing A(S) against the ladder (exists by compactness), derives local single-cut and two-cut re-pairing no-improvement conditions, aims to show these force a rigid pairing shape unrealizable with only n cuts. Never writes the integral/alternating-sum formula for a generic response, so cannot inherit the mass-bound-too-weak failure mode. Entirely open: the two-cut exchange condition (the crux) is not yet even stated precisely.

greedy-halving-adversary.last_note: Closed h(m) vertex c=t in S'' Case (ii) unconditionally for all m>=3 (verified), and used it plus the m=3 Type-A hand enumeration to fully close h(3)'s entire simultaneous-cuts piece; h(m>=4) still open (new 2-cut shapes appear).
greedy-halving-adversary.summary: Explicit bisect-the-max Xiang Yu strategy (potential-function induction) for upper bound + geometric-ladder/superincreasing domination for lower bound; most concrete, main gap is the charging-scheme induction in Step 4.

integer-lattice-reduction.last_note: Core digit/carry mechanism refuted twice with verified exact-fraction counterexamples: (1) fragment denominators need not divide D=2^(n+1)-1 (4/21 example, n=2), (2) bisection of a tail piece is not parity-invariant for the window integral (n=4 example, ratio 5/31 to 7/31). Two reusable lemmas (Rationality Lemma, repaired D*L denominator bound) survive but the approach's central premise is dead. RETHINK.
integer-lattice-reduction.summary: Rewritten round-6 plan (supersedes the orphan round-4 one-liner): rescale by D=2^(n+1)-1 so the ladder becomes the exact integers {2^n,...,1}, aiming to evaluate the certified single-cut-perturbation-identity's correction term (equivalently (star-star)'s window integral) as an exact binary-digit/carry computation rather than a bound, transplanting domination/popcount mechanisms from crux corpus aimo-0141/aimo-0917/aimo-0764. First concrete sub-lemma (tractable, reusable regardless of the rest): minimizing-vertex fragment values are rational with denominator dividing D.

lp-duality-certificate.last_note: Proved new Leave-2-Untouched Theorem (verified) but honestly found the full 120-chamber family provably cannot cover residual R' (exact witness reproduced independently, true optimum ~0.5005 confirms no counterexample to c(4)<=16/31, just family incompleteness); R' still open.
lp-duality-certificate.summary: Abandons induction on n entirely: seeks an explicit LP-duality/Positivstellensatz-style nonnegative-combination certificate proving Phi(S) >= a_n*Total(S) directly over the whole vertex-minimum-theorem polytope, in one shot. Structurally sidesteps the plateau's "needs unavailable upper bound on sub-instance" failure mode since a one-shot certificate never invokes a sub-instance. First deliverable: reverse-engineer a certificate for the fully-closed n=2 case; main open risk is whether a clean certificate-recursion in n exists at all.

minimax-lp-response-polytope.last_note: Reviewer independently re-derived weak LP duality and confirmed it is intrinsically one-directional: constraint-dual mechanism structurally cannot certify case (b2)'s upper bound, for any n/marking/multiplier choice — 6th confirmed-dead mechanism for case (b2); correct redirection to Claim B lower bound noted but not attempted.
minimax-lp-response-polytope.summary: General upper bound c(n)<=a_n via real LP strong duality over Xiang Yu's response polytope (dual multipliers on cut-budget/mass constraints, not a weighted combination of primal strategy values) -- targets case (b2) where 5 prior mechanism families (peel/bisect/recurse, weighted-combination, boundary-continuity, Danskin/concavity, surrogate/majorization) are now confirmed dead.

rank-pigeonhole-budget.last_note: Proved Max Bound + Insertion Sandwich lemmas and combined into a genuinely new Master Theorem (MinFloor(m-1)=>MaxCeil(m) in full); instantiated unconditionally at m=5 closing MaxCeil(5) and (7.9.1) at n=8; correctly scoped as conditional for m>=6. All verified independently, no gaps.
rank-pigeonhole-budget.summary: Discrete majorization/pigeonhole recast of Prop. 10's cross-term "Missing Inequality" (aimo-0718-style): count Xiang Yu's cuts landing in each nested ladder sub-interval, prove a per-level domination lemma bounding how many odd-rank pieces he can steal given his cut budget there, sum to a majorization sandwich recovering a_n as the floor. Genuinely different toolbox (discrete counting) from the four framings (continuum integral / LP-vertex) already stuck on the identical obstruction. Whole ballgame is the domination lemma itself, wholly open.

rank-tie-vertex-reduction.last_note: Proved a rigorous general negative result (Parity Coincidence + Zero-Iff lemmas) ruling out peel-by-ell induction for the general c1>=2 gap; reviewer reconfirmed both lemmas correct. General c1>=2 case still open; real progress via honest, non-numeric dead-end proof, not an empirical guess.
rank-tie-vertex-reduction.summary: Claims the min of Phi over Xiang Yu's response, for a fixed cut-budget composition, is piecewise-linear in the free cut positions and hence attained at an exact rank-tie/boundary vertex, reducing the continuum lower-bound optimization to a finite exact-matching check via leftover-formula, never bounding the cross-term integral. Seeded by a concrete n=3 exact-tie grid-search hit. Main open risk: the vertex-minimum lemma itself unproved and the resulting tie-enumeration not obviously small.

self-similar-bracketing.last_note: Proved achievability at c=n (Lemma B1, certified) but Prop B2 shows the outline's premise was wrong: c=n minimality is not a free endpoint, it embeds the same open cross-term obstruction. Zero progress on the actual interior 1<=c<=n-1 target. RETHINK on framing recommended for next outline.
self-similar-bracketing.summary: Brackets Xiang Yu's cut-budget split c between two now-exact endpoints: c=0 (certified untouched-top-piece bound) and c=n (new this round: rescaled ladder copy fragmenting p_1 entirely via a rigid strict-alternation merge order, algebraically verified, giving exactly Phi=p_1=2^n/(2^{n+1}-1)). Proposes an induction on Xiang Yu's cut count with a ladder-top-dominance invariant to close the interior; invariant not yet stated. Different induction variable (budget split, not n) from every live approach.

self-similar-potential-certificate.last_note: First build: fixed the outline's broken self-similar recursion (proved correct scaling identity f(n)=r(n)f(n-1)), proved a general above-threshold formula (reviewer-verified) that reproduces the c=0 case, and derived a genuine negative result (mass-based interleaving bound is provably too weak for c>=1). Converges onto the same core combinatorial obstruction already identified by greedy-halving-adversary rather than avoiding it.
self-similar-potential-certificate.summary: Single self-similar weight/potential certificate Psi_n tied to the ladder's self-similarity, proving both directions at once via cut-monotonicity induction; naive recursive formula's telescoping check already found to fail (needs rescaled normalization or honest refutation).

smoothing-compactness-certificate.last_note: CHANGES REQUESTED. Proved a fully general, non-numeric General-n Cascade Achievability Theorem (k=n-1,n boundary cascades hit a_n exactly for every n, direct rank-count proof) -- independently verified for n=1..8. Honest negative finding: the n=2 six-template+LP-contradiction mechanism does NOT generalize to n=3 (concrete counterexample (3/8,1/4,1/4,1/8) verified exactly, all 6 templates exceed target, true min needs an ad hoc 7th strategy). Upper-bound generalization beyond n=2 now shown to be genuinely harder than expected.
smoothing-compactness-certificate.summary: Static majorization/smoothing argument: compactness gives an optimal Liu Bang config, local-exchange lemma forces it to be the ladder; genuinely different (uniqueness-of-extremizer) framing from the explicit-strategy approach, but core smoothing lemma has no mechanism yet.
